manifest.name: Cyberpunk
manifest.author: Echo Opera
manifest.description: Gritty neon futures and failing signals: rain-slick streets, datamosh, holograms, CRT burn, cyberspace and HUDs.

styles.name: Neon Rain
styles.blurb: A night street in heavy rain: invented neon signage bleeds into rippling puddles as streaks sheet down.

styles.name: Datamosh
styles.blurb: P-frame bleed: macroblocks drag stale pixels along their motion vectors, chroma smears and keyframes snap back.

styles.name: Holo Decay
styles.blurb: A failing hologram: a turning wireframe form with scanlines, tear bands, colour split and dropouts.

styles.name: Signal Loss
styles.blurb: Worn videotape: tracking errors roll through, chroma bleeds, dropouts streak and the head switch tears the bottom.

styles.name: Megastructure
styles.blurb: A flight through a brutalist arcology: repeating slabs, neon window bands, fog and traffic in the voids.

styles.name: Cipher Fall
styles.blurb: Cascades of invented glyphs pour down in depth layers, heads burning bright and tails decaying.

styles.name: ICE Breach
styles.blurb: Flying low over wireframe cyberspace: data towers stand guard until a red intrusion wave rips through the grid.

styles.name: CRT Burn
styles.blurb: Curved glass, shadow mask, scanlines and halation, with phosphor persistence smearing every move.

styles.name: Pixel Sort
styles.blurb: Threshold-sorted smears: bright spans melt into ordered gradients along a turning axis.

styles.name: Circuit Growth
styles.blurb: Traces autoroute across a board at 45 degrees, vias bloom and current pulses race home.

styles.name: Drone Swarm
styles.blurb: A flock of drones morphs between formations over the city while targeting reticles lock and track.

styles.name: Thermal Scan
styles.blurb: A FLIR sweep over a night street: heat blooms from engines, vents and walkers under a targeting HUD.

styles.name: Chrome Liquid
styles.blurb: Mercury metaballs merge and split, mirroring a neon room in their polished skin.

styles.name: Net Tunnel
styles.blurb: Racing down an endless data corridor: panels of streaming code, light bars and packet trails rush past.

styles.name: Smog Sprawl
styles.blurb: A layered skyline breathes under smog: lit windows, blinking masts, searchlights and air traffic.

styles.name: Bit Crush
styles.blurb: The image collapses in bit depth: ordered dither, palette snapping and pixel blocks that breathe with the loop.

styles.name: EMP
styles.blurb: An electromagnetic pulse tears through the grid: shock rings warp space, arcs crawl and static floods the signal.

styles.name: AR Overlay
styles.blurb: An augmented-reality HUD tracks moving targets over a blurred city: reticles, data tags, rings, tapes and readouts.

files.styles/src-scene.glsl:
// Shared source pass for the signal-damage styles (uses p_source).
vec4 motif(vec2 uv, vec2 fc) { return vec4(CP_scene(uv, p_source), 1.0); }
